---
title: "Spectral Unmixing"
---

AutoSpectral-based spectral unmixing workflow — six step-by-step functions plus
a one-call orchestrator.

## `sw_unmix_setup` {#sw_unmix_setup}

Initialize AutoSpectral parameters and control file.

### Usage

```r
sw_unmix_setup(
  control_dir,
  cytometer = "aurora",
  control_file = NULL,
  output_dir = "SpectraWeaveR_unmix",
  figures = TRUE
)
```

### Arguments

| Argument | Description |
|----------|-------------|
| `control_dir` | Path to the directory containing single-stain control FCS files. |
| `cytometer` | Cytometer model. One of `"aurora"` (default), `"auroraNL"`, `"id7000"`, `"s8"`, `"a8"`, `"a5se"`, `"opteon"`, `"mosaic"`, `"xenith"`. |
| `control_file` | Optional path to an existing control CSV. If `NULL`, a draft is generated from FCS filenames. |
| `output_dir` | Output directory for unmixing results. |
| `figures` | Logical; whether to generate QC figures. |

### Details

Sets up the AutoSpectral parameter list for a given cytometer and either
creates a draft control file CSV from FCS filenames or validates an existing
one. **Step 1 of the unmixing workflow.**

### Value

A named list (class `sw_setup`) with components: `asp` (AutoSpectral
parameters), `control_file`, `control_dir`.

---

## `sw_unmix_prepare` {#sw_unmix_prepare}

Gate, clean, and extract fluorophore spectra from single-stain controls.

### Usage

```r
sw_unmix_prepare(
  setup,
  gating_system = c("landmarks", "density"),
  gate_list = NULL,
  clean = TRUE,
  af_remove = TRUE,
  parallel = FALSE,
  threads = NULL
)
```

### Arguments

| Argument | Description |
|----------|-------------|
| `setup` | An `sw_setup` object from `sw_unmix_setup()`. |
| `gating_system` | Gating method: `"landmarks"` or `"density"`. |
| `gate_list` | Optional pre-defined gates (e.g., from `AutoSpectral::define.gate.landmarks()`). |
| `clean` | Logical; whether to clean controls (AF intrusions, universal negatives). |
| `af_remove` | Logical; whether to remove autofluorescence intrusions. |
| `parallel` | Logical; whether to use parallel processing. |
| `threads` | Number of threads for parallel processing. |

### Details

Loads single-stain control FCS files, applies automated gating, cleans
controls, and extracts fluorophore spectral signatures via robust linear
modelling. **Step 2 of the unmixing workflow.**

### Value

A named list (class `sw_controls`) with components: `flow_control`, `spectra`,
`setup`.

---

## `sw_unmix_extract_af` {#sw_unmix_extract_af}

Extract per-cell autofluorescence spectra from unstained samples.

### Usage

```r
sw_unmix_extract_af(
  unstained_fcs,
  setup,
  spectra,
  refine = TRUE,
  som_dim = 10,
  parallel = TRUE,
  threads = NULL
)
```

### Arguments

| Argument | Description |
|----------|-------------|
| `unstained_fcs` | Path to a single unstained FCS file, or a named list of paths for multi-tissue experiments. |
| `setup` | An `sw_setup` object. |
| `spectra` | Fluorophore spectra matrix from `sw_unmix_prepare()`. |
| `refine` | Logical; whether to perform second-pass refinement. |
| `som_dim` | SOM grid dimension (creates `som_dim²` clusters). |
| `parallel` | Logical; enable parallel processing. |
| `threads` | Number of threads. |

### Details

Captures per-cell autofluorescence variation using SOM clustering. This is
what gives AutoSpectral its edge over conventional unmixing — it models
cell-to-cell AF variation instead of using a single AF spectrum. **Step 3 of
the unmixing workflow.**

### Value

If a single path: a matrix of AF spectra (clusters in rows, detectors in
columns). If a named list: a named list of such matrices.

---

## `sw_unmix_extract_variants` {#sw_unmix_extract_variants}

Map fluorophore emission variability from single-stain controls.

### Usage

```r
sw_unmix_extract_variants(
  setup,
  spectra,
  af_spectra,
  refine = TRUE,
  som_dim = 10,
  n_cells = 2000,
  parallel = FALSE,
  threads = NULL
)
```

### Arguments

| Argument | Description |
|----------|-------------|
| `setup` | An `sw_setup` object. |
| `spectra` | Fluorophore spectra matrix. |
| `af_spectra` | AF spectra matrix (matched to control tissue). |
| `refine` | Logical; second-pass refinement. |
| `som_dim` | SOM grid dimension. |
| `n_cells` | Number of brightest cells per fluorophore to use. |
| `parallel` | Logical; enable parallel processing. |
| `threads` | Number of threads. |

### Details

Captures spectral variation (e.g., tandem dye degradation) that enables
per-cell fluorophore optimisation during unmixing. This step is optional but
recommended — it can significantly reduce spillover spread. **Step 4 of the
unmixing workflow.**

### Value

A list (class `sw_variants`) containing: `thresholds`, `variants`,
`delta.list`, `delta.norms`.

---

## `sw_unmix_run` {#sw_unmix_run}

Unmix spectral flow cytometry data.

### Usage

```r
sw_unmix_run(
  input,
  spectra,
  setup,
  flow_control,
  method = c("AutoSpectral", "OLS", "WLS", "Poisson", "Automatic"),
  af_spectra = NULL,
  spectra_variants = NULL,
  speed = c("fast", "medium", "slow"),
  output_dir = NULL,
  file_suffix = NULL,
  parallel = TRUE,
  threads = NULL,
  chunk_size = 2e6
)
```

### Arguments

| Argument | Description |
|----------|-------------|
| `input` | Path to an FCS file, a vector of file paths, or a directory path. |
| `spectra` | Fluorophore spectra matrix. |
| `setup` | An `sw_setup` object. |
| `flow_control` | Flow control object from `sw_unmix_prepare()`. |
| `method` | Unmixing method. |
| `af_spectra` | AF spectra matrix (required for AutoSpectral/Automatic). |
| `spectra_variants` | An `sw_variants` object (optional but recommended). |
| `speed` | Speed/precision trade-off: `"fast"` (1 variant), `"medium"` (3), `"slow"` (10). |
| `output_dir` | Output directory for unmixed FCS files. |
| `file_suffix` | Suffix appended to output filenames. |
| `parallel` | Logical; enable parallel processing. |
| `threads` | Number of threads. |
| `chunk_size` | Number of events per processing chunk (memory management). |

### Details

Performs spectral unmixing on fully-stained sample FCS files. Supports OLS,
WLS, Poisson, and full AutoSpectral unmixing with per-cell autofluorescence
extraction and fluorophore optimisation. **Step 5 of the unmixing workflow.**

### Value

A named list with components: `output_dir`, `output_files`, `spectra`,
`method`.

---

## `sw_unmix_pipeline` {#sw_unmix_pipeline}

End-to-end unmixing pipeline orchestrator.

### Usage

```r
sw_unmix_pipeline(
  control_dir,
  sample_input,
  unstained_fcs = NULL,
  cytometer = "aurora",
  control_file = NULL,
  method = c("AutoSpectral", "OLS", "WLS", "Poisson", "Automatic"),
  speed = c("fast", "medium", "slow"),
  refine = TRUE,
  output_dir = "SpectraWeaveR_unmix",
  parallel = FALSE,
  threads = NULL,
  gating_system = c("landmarks", "density"),
  som_dim = 10,
  chunk_size = 2e6
)
```

### Arguments

| Argument | Description |
|----------|-------------|
| `control_dir` | Path to single-stain controls directory. |
| `sample_input` | Path to sample FCS file(s) or directory. |
| `unstained_fcs` | Path(s) to unstained FCS file(s). Skipped for OLS/WLS. |
| `cytometer` | Cytometer model string. |
| `control_file` | Path to control CSV file. |
| `method` | Unmixing method. |
| `speed` | Speed/precision trade-off. |
| `refine` | Logical; second-pass AF refinement. |
| `output_dir` | Output directory. |
| `parallel` | Logical; enable parallel processing. |
| `threads` | Number of threads. |
| `gating_system` | Gating method for controls. |
| `som_dim` | SOM grid dimension for AF extraction. |
| `chunk_size` | Chunk size for memory management. |

### Details

Runs the complete AutoSpectral unmixing workflow in a single call: setup →
control preparation → AF extraction → spectral variant mapping → unmixing.
Steps 3–4 are automatically skipped for OLS/WLS methods.

### Value

A named list with all intermediate results: `setup`, `flow_control`,
`spectra`, `af_spectra`, `spectra_variants`, `unmixed`.

---

## `sw_io_load_unmixed` {#sw_io_load_unmixed}

Load pre-unmixed FCS files.

### Usage

```r
sw_io_load_unmixed(fcs_dir, pattern = "\\.fcs$", ...)
```

### Arguments

| Argument | Description |
|----------|-------------|
| `fcs_dir` | Directory containing unmixed FCS files. |
| `pattern` | Regex pattern for file matching (default: `"\\.fcs$"`). |
| `...` | Additional arguments passed to `flowCore::read.flowSet()`. |

### Details

Loads FCS files that have already been spectrally unmixed into a `flowSet`.
Enforces `truncate_max_range = FALSE` for Aurora compatibility.

### Value

A `flowSet` containing all matched FCS files.

---

## `sw_filter_margins` {#sw_filter_margins}

Remove margin events.

### Usage

```r
sw_filter_margins(ff, channel_specs = NULL)
```

### Arguments

| Argument | Description |
|----------|-------------|
| `ff` | A `flowFrame`. |
| `channel_specs` | Optional named list of channel-specific margin specifications. |

### Details

Wrapper for `PeacoQC::RemoveMargins()` that removes events at the margins of
scatter and fluorescence channels. This should be run **before** data
transformation (e.g., arcsinh, logicle). Margin events are cells that saturate
detector limits (floor or ceiling).

### Value

A `flowFrame` with margin events removed.
